import json,multiprocessing,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"/tmp/fossilize-62/final-051c1cd/.agents/skills/implement-change-harness/scripts")
from test_harness_serial_state import SerialStateTests
from test_harness_serial_executor import ProcessFixture
from harness_serial import Runtime,context,read
from harness_state import repository_lock

def owner(repo,ready):
    with repository_lock(repo):
        ready.set();time.sleep(63)

case=SerialStateTests("test_C03_transaction_lock_waits_without_failed_run");case.setUp()
process=None
try:
    case.now=time.time();case.migrate(live=True)
    ctx=context(case.source,"run-1")
    runtime=Runtime(case.root/"probe-runtime",ProcessFixture())
    marker=case.root/"executed"
    job=runtime.submit([sys.executable,"-B","-c","from pathlib import Path;Path("+repr(str(marker))+").write_text('executed')"],case.source,ctx,120)
    ready=multiprocessing.Event();process=multiprocessing.Process(target=owner,args=(str(case.source),ready));process.start();assert ready.wait(10)
    started=time.monotonic();runtime.run(once=True);elapsed=time.monotonic()-started
    before=read(runtime.folder(job)/"record.json")
    process.join(10);assert process.exitcode==0
    runtime.run(once=True);after=read(runtime.folder(job)/"record.json")
    result={"elapsed":elapsed,"before_release_status":before["status"],"after_release_status":after["status"],"reason":after.get("reason"),"launched":job["unit"] in runtime.driver.units,"marker":marker.exists(),"remaining_run_budget":ctx["deadline"]-time.time(),"owned_local_lock_seconds":63,"job_timeout":job["timeout"]}
    Path("/tmp/fossilize-62/final-051c1cd-evidence/long-contention-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps(result))
    assert before["status"]==after["status"]=="failed" and not result["launched"] and not result["marker"] and result["remaining_run_budget"]>0
finally:
    if process and process.is_alive():process.kill();process.join(5)
    case.doCleanups()
